compute_mae: compute mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor dictionaries for MLIP evaluation
compute_mse: compute mean squared error between predicted and target tensor dictionaries for MLIP evaluation
compute_rmse: compute root mean squared error between predicted and target tensor dictionaries for MLIP evaluation
compute_per_atom_mae: compute per-atom normalized mean absolute error dividing by natoms for fair comparison across systems
compute_magnitude_error: compute magnitude error between predicted and target vector norms using configurable p-norm for MLIP evaluation
